param.name: input
param.label: Output of Qualimap BamQC or RNASeq
param.help: Raw data output of Qualimap BamQC (genome_results, coverage_histogram, gc-content_distribution) or Qualimap RNASeq (rnaseq_qc_results, coverage_profile_along_genes_total). Each sample needs its genome_results or rnaseq_qc_results file; the other files are matched to it by the part of their name before the file type (e.g. 'sample1_' after Flatten Collection). Run the Flatten Collection tool to keep all output in one report
